description: This file is a TypeScript source file that sets up and exports testing utilities, matchers, and error classes for Jest testing framework, including custom matchers, promise handling, and error reporting.

classes.name: JestAssertionError
classes.description: Custom error class for Jest assertions, optionally including matcher results.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Main function to create expectation objects with matchers for testing.

methods.name: makeResolveMatcher
methods.description: Creates a matcher for promises that resolve.

methods.name: makeRejectMatcher
methods.description: Creates a matcher for promises that reject.

methods.name: makeThrowingMatcher
methods.description: Wraps a matcher to handle errors and promise results, supporting async matchers.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Generates a message for matcher errors.

methods.name: _validateResult
methods.description: Validates the structure of matcher results.

methods.name: assertions
methods.description: Sets the expected number of assertions for a test.

methods.name: hasAssertions
methods.description: Marks a test as expecting assertions.
